primary_endpoints.definition: Macro-F1 over source-native SPEAK/SILENT labels; include the full confusion matrix and class support.
primary_endpoints.denominator: All eligible decision points in the named dataset/config/split; conditionally eligible subsets also show coverage and the unfiltered total.

primary_endpoints.definition: False SPEAK predictions divided by gold SILENT decisions. Also report FP/(all actual SPEAK outputs) as 1-precision under a separate name.
Eligible fixed-content opportunities first surfaced inside the source or human-annotated turn window.
primary_endpoints.denominator: All eligible candidates, including missed and do-not-surface candidates with separate reasons; turn windows and synthetic seconds are distinct.

primary_endpoints.definition: Source evidence to candidate to accepted to promoted to retrieved/packed lineage, including MUST recall and MUST_NOT false promotion.
primary_endpoints.denominator: Independently annotated storable and forbidden source information, not model-proposed candidates.

primary_endpoints.definition: Source-ID aligned Any/All-Evidence Recall@1/3/5/10, MRR, Precision@K, evidence-in-pack rate, and distractors.
primary_endpoints.denominator: Questions with resolvable gold lineage; report alignment coverage and worst-case bounds separately.

primary_endpoints.definition: Answerable correctness, correct abstention, unsupported answer rate, and answer coverage.
primary_endpoints.denominator: Answerable and unanswerable questions are separate strata.

primary_endpoints.definition: A surfaced reply is useful only when timing, addressee/thread, evidence support, and naturalness all pass; compare paired memory conditions.
primary_endpoints.denominator: All eligible opportunities; also report conditional-on-speaking quality and the no-speech fraction.

primary_endpoints.definition: Unneeded-memory opportunities with irrelevant, stale, wrong-owner, or excessive memory references.
primary_endpoints.denominator: All opportunities annotated as not requiring memory; also report the conditional-on-generated fraction.

hard_gates.target: Complete fingerprint; two fixture replays match event-for-event; bad hashes, mismatched resume, and zero samples are rejected; run counts reconcile.

Zero unauthorized memory access, wrong-person confirmation, stale-evidence resurrection, repeated terminal verification, R=0 proactive delivery, budget double spend, or real-send escape in applicable finite trajectories.

On the same holdout, candidate Macro-F1 paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 versus B-current; false-interruption difference 95% CI upper bound <= +1 percentage point. Always-silent and always-speak remain reported controls.
Chinese insertion-window hit rate >= 80%; early insertion <= 5%; any TTL/stale hard violation fails. PITCH official and alternative annotation scopes remain separate.

No regression in deterministic/privacy/backend parity; production-equivalent write funnel complete; answerable correctness paired 95% CI lower bound > 0; correct-abstention difference lower bound >= -2 percentage points.
Necessary-memory useful-intervention difference lower bound > 0; no-memory overuse difference upper bound <= +1 percentage point; blinded naturalness is not worse than B-current by more than 0.25/5.

Report cost per 1,000 decisions and per successful intervention; zero-model mode makes zero generation calls; local pure-decision P95 <= 100 ms and candidate P95 <= 120% of baseline under the same hardware/cache conditions.
Named authorized QQ/WebChat scope, model, configuration, commit, traceable candidate-to-physical-ACK path, anonymous feedback, and zero hard violations.

statistics.holdout_policy: Select at most one candidate on dev; score holdout once after freeze.
